compiled_state.title: dso_reconciler.__main__._try_load_step omits sys.modules registration -> Python 3.14 dataclass NoneType.__dict__ crash
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* code_version: post-PR-#358
* Python: 3.14 (the new dataclass type-resolution path)
* Failed CI: https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/actions/runs/26424571572

### 2. Incident Overview

Fourth defect in the 5be7 → 96c5 → bbf0 → THIS chain surfaced by live audit-live dry-run.

Expected: __main__._try_load_step("applier") loads applier.py such that ApplyResult dataclass type-resolution works on Python 3.14.

Actual: `_try_load_step` (__main__.py:56-67) uses `spec_from_file_location("dso_reconciler.X", ...)` + exec_module but does NOT register the module in sys.modules. ApplyResult dataclass then has __module__='dso_reconciler.applier' but sys.modules.get('dso_reconciler.applier') returns None, crashing Python 3.14's dataclasses._is_type with "'NoneType' object has no attribute '__dict__'".

Production manifestation: `run_pass raised: 'NoneType' object has no attribute '__dict__'` exit 1.

Same root cause class as the 5 pre-existing reconciler test failures the deep-tier verifier scoped out as "Python 3.14 dataclass compat issue".

### 3. Suspected Categories

* Cluster A residue: PR #345 consolidated sys.modules keys for mode/mutation/advisory_lock/invariants but missed applier
* Loader asymmetry: 3 different sibling-loaders (_load_sibling_keyed, _try_load_step, _load) — only _load_sibling_keyed consistently registers in sys.modules
* Python 3.14 dataclass change makes latent loader bug into hard production failure

### 4. Suggested fix

In _try_load_step, register module in sys.modules BEFORE exec_module:

```python
dotted_name = f"dso_reconciler.{name}"
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(dotted_name, module_path)
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
sys.modules[dotted_name] = mod   # <-- ADD
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
```

Add regression test test_try_load_step_sys_modules.py asserting sys.modules registration + dataclass instantiation works.

### 5. Pattern observation

Meta-bug 5f2a-9a9f-2b4a-4aab tracks the planning/implementation/validation pipeline gaps that allowed 5be7 + 96c5 + bbf0 + this defect to all ship with epic 4047 P1=PASS.
